#### Description
An exception is raised when running ```sfputil reset``` 
```
root@str2-msn4600c-acs-01:/var/log# sudo sfputil reset Ethernet288
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/sfputil", line 8, in <module>
    sys.exit(cli())
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 764, in __call__
    return self.main(*args, **kwargs)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 717, in main
    rv = self.invoke(ctx)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 1134, in invoke
    Command.invoke(self, ctx)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 956, in invoke
    return ctx.invoke(self.callback, **ctx.params)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 555, in invoke
    return callback(*args, **kwargs)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/sfputil/main.py", line 302, in cli
    err = load_platform_sfputil()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/dist-packages/sfputil/main.py", line 281, in load_platform_sfputil
    platform_sfputil = platform_sfputil_class()
  File "/usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-mlnx_msn4600c-r0/plugins/sfputil.py", line 103, in __init__
    port_position_tuple = self.get_port_position_tuple_by_platform_name()
  File "/usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-mlnx_msn4600c-r0/plugins/sfputil.py", line 99, in get_port_position_tuple_by_platform_name
    position_tuple = port_position_tuple_list[platform_dict[out.rstrip('\n')]]
KeyError: 'x86_64-mlnx_msn4600c-r0'
```
It's because there is no key named ```x86_64-mlnx_msn4600c-r0``` in ```platform_dict```
```
(Pdb) platform_dict
{'x86_64-mlnx_msn2700-r0': 0, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn2740-r0': 0, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn2100-r0': 1, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn2410-r0': 2, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn2010-r0': 3, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn3420-r0': 5, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn3700-r0': 0, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn3700c-r0': 0, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn3800-r0': 4, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn4600-r0': 4, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn4600c': 4, 'x86_64-mlnx_msn4700-r0': 0}
```

-->

Signed-off-by: Kebo Liu <kebol@nvidia.com>

#### Why I did it

Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/7162
The platform name for MSN4600C in sfputil pliugin is not complete:  "x86_64-mlnx_msn4600c" -> "x86_64-mlnx_msn4600c-r0"

#### How I did it

Correct the platform name

#### How to verify it

run "sfputil show presence" command
